official: 食品衛生法に基づく営業の施設基準等に関する条例の一部を改正 する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 審議結果

name: 無人の全自動調理機に衛生基準を設定
summary: 県の条例は、食品を扱う営業施設に必要な衛生基準を定めています。この議案は、従業者が常駐せず全自動調理機で調理した食品を販売する営業について、一部の基準を適用せず、監視設備や異常時の停止機能などの要件を定めます。
changes: 施設全体の衛生状況を確認する監視設備を設ける
異常時に営業者が機械を停止でき、機械も異常を検知して自動停止する機能を備える
調理後の食品の保管設備に汚染を防ぐ構造を設け、一定時間経過後は提供しない機能を備える
営業者の連絡先を掲示し、既存の衛生基準の一部を適用しない
who: 従業者が常駐せず、全自動調理機で調理した食品を販売する事業者

en.name: Sets hygiene standards for unmanned fully automated cooking machines
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance Concerning Facility Standards, etc. for Businesses under the Food Sanitation Act
en.summary: The prefectural ordinance sets hygiene standards required for facilities that handle food. This bill exempts businesses that sell food prepared by fully automated cooking machines, with no employees permanently stationed, from some of these standards. It also sets requirements such as monitoring equipment and a function to stop the machine when an abnormality occurs.
changes: Install monitoring equipment to check hygiene conditions throughout the facility
Allow the operator to stop the machine when an abnormality occurs, and equip the machine with a function to detect abnormalities and stop automatically
Equip storage facilities for food after cooking with structures that prevent contamination, and provide a function that prevents food from being served after a set period of time
Display the operator’s contact information and exempt the business from some existing hygiene standards
who: Businesses that sell food prepared by fully automated cooking machines, with no employees permanently stationed
